title: OneTomorrow Scores at 2019 Workplace Giving Awards
body:
It’s with great pride that we announce the successful recognition of the One Tomorrow Charitable Fund at the 2019 Workplace Giving Excellence Awards.

OneTomorrow has been recognised with a bronze medal for its innovation and commitment to the global community through its staff Workplace Giving program.

The fourth annual awards took place in 2019, recognising the most outstanding workplace giving programs across Australia. In attendance were the Hon Gary Johns Commissioner, the ACNC, and CEOs from the country’s leading business and Not-For-Profit organisations.

Workplace Giving is known to engage employees, improve business performance and have an enormous impact on the community. It’s our chance to make a meaningful contribution to support the OneTomorrow vision.

OneTomorrow’s encouragement of Workplace Giving was demonstrated by offering to triple staff donations for those who signed up in August for the first three months, and matching staff donations thereafter.

All funds raised through the program, which continues to grow in its success, go towards local charity partners selected by our body of staff.
